description: Returns the interest payment for a given period for an investment, based on periodic, constant payments and a constant interest rate.

params.description: The interest rate per period. For example, use 6%/4 for quarterly payments at 6% APR.
params.name: arg1

params.description: The period for which the interest will be returned. It must be in the range from 1 to the total number of payments.
params.name: arg2

params.description: The total number of payment periods in an investment.
params.name: arg3

params.description: The present value, or the lump-sum amount that a series of future payments is worth now.
params.name: arg4

params.description: The future value, or a cash balance which will be attained after the last payment is made. If omitted, it is equal to 0.
params.name: arg5

params.description: A logical value representing the timing of payment: at the end of the period = 0 or omitted, at the beginning of the period = 1.
params.name: arg6

signature: IPMT(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg3: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg4: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg5?: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg6?: ApiRange | ApiName | number): number
